verdict.rationale: The only examples-related evidence is a runtime probe showing phaser.io/llms.txt is live as a programmatic Phaser Examples Index, with full metadata and source code via GET /api/v1/examples/{id}. The concept docs also include inline code snippets such as this.add.sprite. Nothing shows an interactive API reference or that these examples can be run in-browser or in a live sandbox, and the docs-subdomain llms.txt and .md probes return 404. Missing for 10: an interactive API reference, runnable/editable examples, first-party documentation of the examples experience, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
